title: Sales Engineer
description:
Sales Engineers drive revenue. Every demo, discovery call, and RFP response you deliver has one purpose: to move a deal forward and win it.
As a Sales Engineer, you are the technical half of the sales team. You are measured on pipeline, win rate, and speed, not on how many demos you ran. You will work a high volume of opportunities, qualify them quickly, make a compelling technical case, and keep deals moving from first conversation to closed-won. When a deal needs deep architecture work, you bring in our Solution Engineering team. When it closes, you hand off a clean, well-documented win.
If you are energized by competing, closing, and being part of a team that wins, this is the role.

title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
The Opportunity
QuidelOrtho unites the strengths of Quidel Corporation and Ortho Clinical Diagnostics, creating a world-leading in vitro diagnostics company with award-winning expertise in immunoassay and molecular testing, clinical chemistry and transfusion medicine. We are more than 6,000 strong and do business in over 130 countries, providing answers with fast, accurate and consistent testing where and when they are needed most - home to hospital, lab to clinic.
Our culture puts our team members first and prioritizes actions that support happiness, inspiration and engagement. We strive to build meaningful connections with each other as we believe that employee happiness and business success are linked. Join us in our mission to transform the power of diagnostics into a healthier future for all.
The Role:
At QuidelOrtho , we’re advancing the power of diagnostics for a healthier future for all. Join our mission as our next Senior Regulatory Affairs Manager. This role manages regulatory activities related to the development and approval of new in vitro diagnostics and medical devices into the worldwide market, as directed. Reviews and approves U.S. and IVDR regulatory submissions. Interacts with regulatory agencies regarding product registrations, licensures, and permits and supports regulatory compliance to QSR, ISO, CMDR, MDSAP, IVDD/IVDR, CFR and other worldwide regulatory requirements. Promotes awareness of applicable regulatory and customer requirements to cross functional partners during new product development and life cycle management projects.
This position is remote eligible for candidates located in the United States.
The Responsibilities:

• Manages new product development and U.S. submissions activities for a set of medical devices and/or IVD products.

• Works as primary core team member on new molecular product development teams and establishes regulatory strategy to achieve market clearance.

• Prepares, reviews and approves U.S. (FDA) product submissions; reviews and approves other regulatory documentation generated during the new product development effort to support international product submissions and registrations.

• Supervises interactions with government agencies for regulatory submissions.

• Reviews and approves verification and validation protocols and reports; advises on best practices for data presentation in regulatory submissions.

• Reviews and approves Marketing/Sales literature and labeling.

• Establishes and/or owns regulatory affairs processes and acts as subject matter expert during inspections.

• Develops and presents training materials for regulatory requirements and/or department processes.

• Evaluates change control documents for impact on regulatory submissions and filing requirements, as needed.

• Research regulations and competitor products and creates summaries for departmental use.

• Implements, manages, and continuously improves related regulatory processes, tools, and trackers

• Ensures regulatory records are complete and well organized.

• Carries out duties in compliance with established business policies.

• Perform other duties & projects as assigned.

The Individual
Required:

• Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in a scientific discipline

• Minimum of 12 years prior experience in the IVD (in vitro diagnostic), medical device or bio/pharma industry manufacturing environment

• Minimum of 12 years prior experience in Regulatory Affairs (or related educational/work experience) with progression of responsibility and leadership

• Must have prior experience in the preparation and submission of regulatory documentation including, but not limited to, 510(k) submissions, international registrations, and EU technical documentation files. 510 (k) submission approvals required for molecular products and point of care products.

• Must have prior experience as a core team member on product development teams.

• Must have prior direct interaction with FDA and other regulatory agencies.

description:

This is more than a traditional accounting role. You’ll own full-cycle accounting processes, oversee month-end close activities, maintain compliance with GAAP/IFRS standards, support audits, and help strengthen financial operations through process improvements and automation.
You’ll work closely with finance leadership, FP&A, operations, auditors, and cross-functional teams to ensure the company’s financial records remain accurate, compliant, scalable, and actionable.
If you enjoy combining technical accounting expertise with financial analysis and process improvement, this role is a strong fit.
What You’ll Own
General Ledger & Accounting Operations

• Prepare and post journal entries for:

• Accruals

• Prepaids

• Payroll allocations

• Depreciation

• Deferred revenue

• Intercompany transactions

• Maintain reconciliations across:

• Cash

• Accounts Receivable

• Accounts Payable

• Inventory

• Liabilities

• Review general ledger activity and investigate anomalies.

• Ensure accounting records remain accurate, complete, and well documented.

Month-End & Quarter-End Close

• Lead monthly and quarterly close processes.

• Maintain detailed close schedules and checklists.

• Coordinate close activities across departments.

• Prepare trial balances and supporting schedules.

• Ensure all reconciliations are completed accurately and on time.

• Support a month-end close target of five business days .

Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Prepare monthly financial statements including:

• Profit & Loss (P&L)

• Balance Sheet

• Cash Flow Statement

• Perform variance analysis against budgets and forecasts.

• Deliver executive-ready financial commentary and insights.

• Support:

• Management reporting

• Board reporting

• Financial planning initiatives

Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls

• Prepare PBC (Prepared By Client) schedules for external audits.

• Maintain audit-ready accounting documentation.

• Ensure compliance with:

• GAAP

• IFRS

• Internal accounting policies

• Support tax-related documentation including:

• Sales tax

• Property tax

• Corporate tax filings

• Strengthen accounting controls and financial governance.

Process Improvement & Automation

• Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows.

• Support ERP optimization and accounting system enhancements.

• Develop and improve accounting SOPs.

• Increase reporting efficiency through automation.

• Improve reconciliation processes and financial accuracy.

Team Collaboration & Financial Support

• Review work completed by Staff Accountants and Bookkeepers.

• Mentor junior accounting team members.

• Partner with:

• FP&A

• Operations

• Leadership

• Support revenue recognition and operational accounting initiatives.

• Help improve collaboration across finance and business teams.

Requirements
Must-Have Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 4-5+ years of progressive accounting experience.

• GAAP

We are looking for a senior Product professional with strong experience across CRM, Player Lifecycle, BI / Data Products, Data Governance, and regulated product environments.

Player Segmentation & Tagging
Lifecycle Management

Support or own platform capabilities involving accounts and identity, wallets, payments, gaming/content integrations, customer service, and operational back-office systems.

Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Data, QA, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Security, Finance, and Commercial teams.

title: FDE Subject Matter Expert

Description
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners - people with no prior tech background - through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.
Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

• Design and build the projects students work on end to end - scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.

• Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently.

• Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.

• Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.

• Contribute to sales and marketing enablement - training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

Requirements

• 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).

• Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments - first call through production go-live and adoption.

• Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).

• Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.

• Strong written communication in English - you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.

• Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

Preferred experience:

• Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

• Fully remote work.

• A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.

• Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.

• A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

This role analyzes large and complex datasets, fraud alerts, customer and transaction activity, and emerging fraud trends to support timely risk-based decisions, reduce fraud losses, strengthen controls, and ensure regulatory expectations are met. ​

title: Director, Project Controls, Project & Development Services (Data Centers)
description:
Job Title
Director, Project Controls, Project & Development Services (Data Centers) Job Description Summary
This Director-level role will serve as the strategic lead and primary client interface for all planning and scheduling functions across large-scale capital programs, with a strong focus on data center delivery. The individual will operate as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, shaping program strategy through the development of high-level integrated schedules, resource plans, and delivery frameworks from early planning through execution and closeout.

The Director will lead the establishment of best-in-class scheduling standards, governance, and reporting while building and mentoring high-performing teams. This role requires a balance of strategic insight and technical expertise, with the ability to influence outcomes, drive alignment across complex stakeholder groups, and ensure successful program delivery. Job Description

Responsibilities

• Lead the development and implementation of enterprise-level schedule management frameworks across major capital programs, including tools, processes, governance, and reporting standards.

• Serve as the primary planning and scheduling advisor to client leadership, providing strategic guidance on program phasing, sequencing, and delivery risks.

• Develop and oversee integrated master schedules aligning design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operations across complex programs.

• Drive alignment across internal teams, contractors, designers, and third parties to ensure integration into a single source of truth schedule.

• Establish program-level reporting structures, KPIs, and executive dashboards to communicate schedule performance, risks, and trends.

• Lead scenario planning, what-if analysis, and quantitative risk assessments to support key program decisions.

• Identify and communicate critical path impacts, schedule risks, and mitigation strategies at both project and program levels.

• Oversee schedule quality, data integrity, and consistency across all projects within the program.

• Partner with cost, commercial, and project management leads to align schedule with financial and operational objectives.

• Build, lead, and mentor a team of schedulers and planners, establishing a culture of accountability, development, and continuous improvement.

• Support business development efforts by contributing to proposals, client presentations, and thought leadership related to project controls and scheduling.

• Act as a visible leader within both the client organization and internal teams, reinforcing best practices and driving delivery excellence.

Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field.

• 12-15+ years of experience in planning and scheduling for large-scale capital programs, including design and construction phases.

• Demonstrated experience operating at a program or portfolio level, ideally in a client-facing leadership capacity.

• Strong experience in advanced tech, mission critical and/or data center projects required, with an understanding of delivery, fast-track schedules, and commissioning requirements.

• Expertise in Primavera P6 (required); experience with additional planning tools and data visualization platforms preferred.

• Proven ability to lead teams within complex, matrixed environments and influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to connect schedule performance to cost, risk, and business outcomes.

• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present to executive audiences and translate complex data into clear insights.

Cushman & Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are
We are a fast-growing vertical SaaS company leveraging innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability within the plastic surgery industry. Our team thrives on challenges, embraces change, and is dedicated to transforming how the industry operates.
Our platform is what aesthetic medicine and plastic surgery practices run their business on, covering scheduling, clinical records, forms and consents, invoicing and payments, patient communications, and the marketing that sits in front of all of it. It is a multi-tenant platform holding millions of patient records under HIPAA and GDPR, and we onboard new practices every month.
Who We’re Looking For
We are builders. An engineer here owns a whole problem, from the first conversation to production. We build with AI as the default: coding agents draft fast, and knowing what to build and what is wrong with the draft is the skill we hire for and level on.
We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to change that. Staff at Adoreal means expert, discover, lead, and the bar is absolute: you would be recognized as Staff at any strong engineering company, and the level travels with you.
The work in front of you is concrete. A .NET estate of roughly 80 repositories to bring onto .NET 8 against a hard support deadline. Tenant isolation in a HIPAA platform that needs to be made provably right, not just believed to be. A CI pipeline that costs eighteen minutes a change and should cost a fraction of that. AI features, including an ambient clinical scribe, moving from pilot to product. Tell us which of these you would take first.
Responsibilities
Architecture across teams

• Own cross-team initiatives problem to production, including the parts nobody else claims.

• Own architecture across teams and find the simplifications that remove whole classes of work and defects, including the systemic friction of shared repositories, environment contention and queue bottlenecks.

• Design the quality architecture across teams: gate standards, observability baselines, safe-migration patterns. Find systemic quality risks before they find us.
Building with AI, and building AI

• Define how Adoreal engineers with AI across the organization: the workflows, the shared infrastructure, and the verification practices other teams adopt, holding AI-drafted work to the same review bar as any other.

• Evaluate emerging capability on a regular rhythm, measure its real impact, and retire what stops earning its place.

• Ship AI into the product: clinical documentation, patient communication, and the intelligence our clinics’ data makes possible, built to HIPAA and GDPR standards from the first design.
Multiplying the organization

• Mentor senior engineers, shape the hiring bar, and be a go-to across the organization.

• Take the hardest reviews in the codebase, and teach through them rather than gate.

• Partner with product leadership so that the systems you design are built for where the business is going, not where it has been.
Requirements

• 10+ years building production software in C# and .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework, with a track record of owning architecture and delivery across multiple teams, not only within one.

• PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and AWS in production. Angular is a strong plus.

• Daily use of coding agents in your own engineering work.

• At least one production feature built on large language models that you shipped and operated.

• Systems built or operated under HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2 or comparable regulation.

• Written and spoken communication that works across time zones and with colleagues whose first language is not English. Most of our engineers are in Latin America.
Benefits
Why Adoreal ?
Joining Adoreal means becoming part of a high-performing, ambitious team that works hard, achieves extraordinary results, and enjoys the rewards that follow. Every employee receives equity, aligning us all in our shared success. P

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
About PrePass
PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates-creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.
That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.
About the Role
As PrePass scales from a bypass-and-tolling provider into a unified compliance ecosystem, the complexity of delivering software has grown dramatically. Multiple product lines, a newly acquired codebase, state agency integrations, and partner marketplace commitments all compete for engineering capacity. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to bring structure, predictability, and cross-team alignment to how we plan, execute, and ship.
This is a high-visibility role working at the intersection of engineering, product, and operations - someone who can translate roadmap ambitions into realistic delivery plans and hold the organization accountable to them.
Problems You'll Help Solve
Unpredictable Release Cadence
Teams building across bypass, tolling, compliance, and hardware-integrated systems operate on different rhythms. Create and maintain a structured release calendar to reduce surprises for customers, state agency partners, and internal stakeholders.
Engineering Capacity Visibility
Leadership needs to make portfolio-level tradeoffs (new integrations vs. platform stability vs. compliance features) but lacks a consistent view of what teams are working on and when it will land.
Cross-Team Dependency Management
A delay in any one integration/update/tool can block multiple teams. Dependencies need owners and visibility.
Essential Responsibilities
Program Planning & Delivery

• Own the integrated delivery roadmap across PrePass product lines: bypass, toll management, safety alerts, INFORM analytics, and compliance.

• Establish and maintain a dependable release schedule, coordinating across engineering, product, QA, and operations.

• Drive program kickoffs, milestone reviews, and retrospectives - creating accountability without unnecessary bureaucracy.

• Translate product roadmap priorities into phased, executable plans with clear owners, timelines, and risk mitigations.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Map and track cross-team dependencies, escalating blockers before they become delays.

• Facilitate alignment between engineering teams.

Visibility & Reporting

• Build and maintain program dashboards that give engineering leadership and the CTO a real-time view of delivery health.

• Produce clear, concise executive status updates - surfacing risks, decisions needed, and milestone progress without noise.

• Define and track engineering KPIs: cycle time, release frequency, defect escape rate, and on-time delivery percentage.

Process Improvement

• Identify and eliminate recurring sources of delay - unclear requirements, late dependency discovery, incomplete acceptance criteria.

• Standardize Agile ceremony practices across teams to improve sprint predictability and retrospective follow-through.

• Lead post-incident reviews on missed releases, building a culture of blameless learning.

Requirements
Qualifications

• 5+ years of program or project management experience in a software product company.

• Demonstrated track record of improving release predictability across multiple en

title: Researcher, Misalignment Monitoring Lead
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI's Safety Research organization works to ensure that our most capable AI models can be deployed safely and responsibly. As frontier models become increasingly capable and autonomous, developing reliable ways to monitor their behavior, identify emerging risks, and evaluate the effectiveness of safety systems becomes increasingly important.

Our work focuses on advancing the research and evaluation methods needed to understand model behavior and ensure that monitoring systems remain effective as model capabilities evolve. We combine rigorous empirical research with practical safety interventions, working closely with research, engineering, and deployment teams to translate findings into improvements across OpenAI's models and products.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior researcher to lead technical work on misalignment monitoring for frontier AI systems. You will develop methods to evaluate the effectiveness of AI monitors, understand their limitations, and improve our ability to detect and stop concerning model behavior reliably.

This role combines research leadership with hands-on technical execution. You will set research priorities, design rigorous evaluations, investigate monitoring failures, and develop approaches for stress-testing and improving monitoring systems. A key focus will be understanding where monitors produce false positives, miss important behaviors, or become less effective as models grow more capable.

You will work closely with researchers and engineers across OpenAI to turn monitoring research into practical improvements to our safety systems. We are looking for someone with strong research judgment, technical depth, and the ability to independently drive ambiguous problems from initial investigation through measurable results.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Lead the research and technical direction for evaluating and improving the misalignment monitoring of frontier AI systems.

- Design and execute rigorous evaluations that measure monitor effectiveness, identify failure modes, and assess the reliability of monitoring signals.

- Develop methods to stress-test and red-team monitors, including identifying behaviors that evade detection or expose weaknesses in existing approaches.

- Investigate false positives, missed detections, and other monitoring failures to improve the accuracy and usefulness of safety evaluations.

- Build scalable evaluation frameworks and experimental tools that enable ongoing measurement of monitoring performance as model capabilities evolve.

- Translate research findings into actionable improvements, working with partner teams to strengthen monitoring systems and inform broader safety decisions.

- Establish research priorities and guide technical execution, balancing foundational research questions with practical deployment needs.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have a strong background in machine learning research, particularly in model evaluations, AI safety, alignment, robustness, or related areas.

- Have demonstrated the ability to lead technically challenging research projects, from identifying important questions through designing experiments and delivering results.

Overview
Who We Are
Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform-bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.
Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.
Responsibilities
Senior Counsel, Commercial Transactions (TPA)
Ready to close the deals that power self-funded health plans?
Why This Role Matters
Behind every self-funded employer plan we administer sits a web of contracts, and those contracts decide how fast we can move, how well we serve plan sponsors, and how confidently we stand behind our promises. As Senior Counsel on Personify Health ’s commercial legal team, you’ll build the agreements that make our TPA business work, from client administrative services agreements to the network, pharmacy, stop-loss, and vendor partnerships behind them. You’ll partner directly with Sales, Account Management, Operations, Finance, and Procurement, giving them clear, practical legal guidance that keeps deals compliant and moving. Reporting to the SVP, Legal, you’ll run your own practice and own your transactions from first draft to signature. When your contracts are sharp and your counsel is trusted, our teams win business faster and our members get the care and coverage they count on.
What You’ll Actually Do

•
Draft, negotiate, and close TPA client agreements: Own administrative services agreements, renewals, amendments, fee schedules, performance guarantees, business associate agreements, and implementation, transition, and termination provisions for self-funded ERISA and non-ERISA (governmental and church) plan sponsors, so clients get clear terms and we get workable ones.

•
Support the broader commercial portfolio: Handle wellbeing platform and services agreements plus strategic partnership and channel agreements, keeping the full range of Personify Health offerings on solid contractual footing.

•
Negotiate vendor, network, and partner agreements: Manage provider network and rental network access, pharmacy benefit, stop-loss, cost-containment and claims editing, care navigation, and point-solution vendor contracts that keep TPA operations running smoothly.

•
Advise on ERISA and health plan compliance in contracting: Guide fiduciary and plan administrator role allocation, alignment with plan documents and SPDs, claims and appeals procedures, COBRA, the No Surprises Act, and transparency requirements, working alongside the plan documents and regulatory compliance teams.

•
Serve as the legal go-to for the business: Resolve questions on contract interpretation, client and vendor escalations, and disputes for Sales, Account Management, Finance, Operations, and Procurement.

•
Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Keep contract templates, negotiation playbooks, and fallback positions current so the business negotiates consistently and closes faster.

•
Anticipate and assess risk: Spot issues early, weigh risk strategically and practically, and deliver clear recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership.

•
Counsel senior leaders: Advise executives on deal structure, risk tradeoffs, and commercial terms, translating legal complexity into decisions the business can act on.

•
Run a high-volume practice independently: Manage your own docket across many contract types, taking transactions from intake through execution with minimal oversight.

Qualifications
What You Bring to Our Team
Education & Experience:

• Juris Doctor and active license in good standing in at least one U.S. state

• At least 5 years of legal practice

• Experience in the self-funded health plan space strongly preferred, gained at a TPA, health plan, national carrier,

• Partner with Cyber Defense and engineering as a technical peer to translate intelligence into mitigation and detection strategies.

• Help guide our intel-architecture requirements, working with engineers to shape the tooling, automation, and data flows that support the team, without needing to be the engineer yourself.

• Help shape and evolve our Priority Intelligence Requirements and Collection Requirements as the threat landscape shifts.

title: Läkarstudent till Velora
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens vård för personer med övervikt/obesitas?
Bygg spetskompetens inom obesitasbehandling redan under studietiden. Velora är en digital specialistklinik för behandling av övervikt/obesitas med mål är att ingen ska behöva vara fast i ofrivillig övervikt. Med en kombination av modern forskning, teknik och ett holistiskt synsätt är vi på god väg. Vi söker nu dig som är läkarstudent till vårt växande team.
Utöver möjligheten att verkligen göra skillnad för en eftersatt patientgrupp erbjuder vi både möjlighet till arbete på distans och flexibla arbetstider. Vi tror på att nöjd personal är nyckeln till nöjda patienter. Veloras arbetsklimat präglas av framåtanda, arbetsglädje och gemenskap. Vi brinner för det vi gör och har stor yrkesstolthet kring den vård vi bedriver.
Uppdraget
Du ringer patienter som har avslutat sin behandling hos oss eller har valt att inte gå vidare med den. Du följer upp hur det har gått och svarar på frågor om behandlingen. Du hjälper också patienten att förstå vad viktnedgång och fortsatt behandling kan betyda för hälsan, till exempel för blodtryck, blodsocker, blodfetter, ledbesvär och sömn. Du tränar på att möta patienter i väldigt olika situationer och att föra samtal som kräver både kunskap och lyhördhet. Den information du samlar in använder vi när vi utvecklar vården.
Vem du är
Du är trygg och lyhörd i telefonsamtal och uttrycker dig varmt och tydligt, även i känsliga situationer. Du har god självinsikt, är strukturerad i din dokumentation och hanterar patientuppgifter med hög integritet. Du bidrar med energi och engagemang, och andra trivs med att samarbeta med dig.
Kvalifikationer

• Du studerar på läkarprogrammet, gärna termin 6 eller senare

• Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

• Du är noggrann och strukturerad i din dokumentation

• Du kan arbeta regelbundet under en längre period

Därför stärker detta din karriär
Obesitas är en av vår tids största folksjukdomar och berör nästan alla specialiteter, från allmänmedicin och internmedicin till kirurgi och psykiatri. Hos oss får du:

• Fördjupad kunskap om modern obesitasbehandling, inklusive GLP-1-baserade läkemedel

• Vana att föra svåra och känsliga samtal, en av de viktigaste färdigheterna i läkaryrket

• Konkret erfarenhet av patientkommunikation som du kan sätta på ditt CV och ta med dig till BT och vidare

• Insikt i hur digital vård fungerar i praktiken Referenser från en specialistklinik

Meriterande

• Erfarenhet av svåra eller känsliga samtal.

• Intresse för eller erfarenhet av arbete med personer med övervikt eller obesitas

Arbetstid & ersättning
Rollen kräver att du kan arbeta regelbundet, till exempel 2 timmar varannan dag eller 1 timme om dagen. Du väljer själv när du arbetar, vardagar mellan 10.00 och 20.00. Du får fast timlön med möjlighet till extra ersättning
Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
Vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

title: Solution Architect-Texas
description:
THE ROLE

As an Enterprise Solutions Architect at ClickHouse, you'll own the technical side of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts in Texas. This role serves our Enterprise segment in Texas, and the ideal candidate would be based in Austin or Dallas.

You'll engage with data platform engineers, architects, SRE, and the VP who owns the standard - and your job is to design something that satisfies all of them and then prove it at production scale.

Getting an enterprise team there usually means moving them off something else, so most of your work is making that migration credible: the architecture, benchmarks run against their own data, and a plan their engineers believe they can execute.

This is a role for engineers who want the hard version of the problem: real scale, real constraints, and an incumbent to displace. Prior pre-sales experience helps but isn't required - technical depth is non-negotiable.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Own the technical evaluation for enterprise accounts - from discovery through POC or competitive bake-off, architecture sign-off, security review, and first production workload.

- Engage across a wider set of stakeholders than a single team: data platform engineers, architects, SRE, security, and the executive who owns the standard. Design solutions that hold up with all of them in the room.

- Design for production scale - sizing, sharding and replication strategy, ingestion topology, tiered storage, cost modeling, and what happens when something fails at 3am.

- Win competitive displacements against Elasticsearch, Splunk, Snowflake, BigQuery, Druid, Pinot, and homegrown systems, using benchmarks the customer's own team can reproduce.

- Own the migration plan - sequencing, dual-run, validation, and cutover - so the customer's team can see exactly how they get to production.

- Clear the security and procurement path: questionnaires, compliance artifacts, network and identity architecture, and BYOC or private deployment requirements.

- Partner closely with Enterprise AEs to progress and close opportunities - you own the technical win, they own the commercial close. Build the TCO case against the incumbent/competition together.

- Advocate for customer needs internally with Product and Engineering - you're the voice of the technical buyer inside ClickHouse.

- Contribute reference architectures, benchmark harnesses, migration guides, and objection handling material that help the team scale what's working.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Deep technical foundation in data infrastructure - built through experience as a data engineer, platform engineer, software engineer, DBA, or solutions architect.

- Production experience with analytical databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, Pinot, Vertica) and with operating them, not just querying them.

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Motion Designer to help shape how SpaceXSI moves and shows up in the world. This role is built for someone who has built motion systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made. You'll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXSI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help define both the motion language of the brand and how it comes to life in our campaigns and products.
This is a hands-on role. Much of the foundation is still being built, so you'll spend real time animating and making things yourself. What you'll do

- Motion system: Define and extend the brand's motion language (timing, easing, transitions, logo animation, typography in motion, and graphic behaviors) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly.

- Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring motion work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand motion without you in the room.

- Campaigns: Concept and produce motion end to end, from storyboards through final delivery, across launch films, product videos, social, paid, web, and out-of-home.

- Product motion: Partner with product designers and engineers to bring brand motion into product surfaces, from interactions and transitions to onboarding and launch moments.

- Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a motion point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders.

- Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output.

What you bring

- 6+ years of motion design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio.

- Fluency in After Effects, Cinema 4D or Blender, Figma, and Adobe Creative Cloud.

- Experience in AI coding tools, especially Cursor. You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering.

- Hands-on experience with AI video and image generation tools as part of a real production workflow.

- A reel and portfolio that show both motion system work and shipped campaigns. Bonus if they include tools or workflows you built.

- Sharp instincts for timing, rhythm, typography in motion, and storytelling.

- Experience in animation workflows from conceptualization, storyboard design, to execution

- A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales.

- Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike.

- Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity.

As vCluster Labs’ Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you aren’t just writing code; you are defining the future of tenant isolation. In this role, you will serve as a core architect of the vCluster Platform, tasked with navigating complex Kubernetes internals to build tools used by the world's leading engineering teams.

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), your role will include:

- Open Source Innovation: Engage with the community and contribute to our open-source projects. You will help define the next generation of tenancy models, creating scalable solutions for isolation and resource sharing beyond simple namespaces.

- Technical Problem Solving: Tackle hard engineering challenges where the solution isn't always on ChatGPT, requiring a deep understanding of systems architecture.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

- Kubernetes Mastery: Deep expertise in Kubernetes internals. We value a profound understanding of how Kubernetes works (architectural patterns, networking, storage).

- Technical Proficiency: Strong programming skills in Go. While Kubernetes knowledge is paramount, you must be able to translate that knowledge into clean, efficient Go code.

- Builder Mindset: You build things outside of work. You have active GitHub projects, experiments, or open-source contributions that demonstrate your passion for building.

- High Agency: You are highly technical and self-driven. You thrive in environments where you are expected to identify problems and solve them autonomously.

- Start-Up Grit: Experience working in a high-growth environment. You are comfortable with ambiguity and eager to make an impact.

Bonus points for:

- Community Contributions: A history of contributions to the Kubernetes project (Upstream), including documentation updates, Pull Requests (PRs), or active participation in Special Interest Groups (SIGs).

- Startup Experience: You have been at an early-stage organization where you function autonomously and strive towards building something great.

ABOUT VCLUSTER LABS

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. title: In-house Legal Counsel
description:
Salonkee is one of Europe’s fastest-growing beauty-tech companies, helping thousands of salons simplify their daily operations and offer an outstanding experience to their clients.

Our all-in-one software simplifies appointment scheduling, payments, and client management, allowing salons to focus on what truly matters: delivering an exceptional customer experience.

We’re proud to shape the future of the beauty industry with innovation, collaboration, and a people-first mindset.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As our first in-house lawyer, you'll own Salonkee's legal and compliance work across six markets and build the function as we grow. It's a hybrid, hands-on role: contracts, privacy, employment and security topics, often in the same week. You'll work with every team, alongside our outside law firms and our external data protection officer (DPO).

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Data protection: lead our privacy programme under the GDPR and Swiss data protection law with our external DPO, including our sub-processor list and contact with data protection authorities.

- Security and privacy: partner with head of departments on privacy reviews of new tools and internally built apps, and lead the legal side of incident response.

- Policies and training: write and maintain our internal rules on customer data and AI use, and train our teams from Sales to Customer Support.

- Digital regulation: advise on EU rules for platforms, consumers and AI, including the Digital Services Act, the AI Act, the Data Act and NIS2.

- Contracts: own our standard terms and negotiate partner, supplier, payment and enterprise agreements.

- Employment: advise HR and managers on labour law across our markets.

- Disputes: handle claims and disputes, working with outside counsel when needed.

- Strategy: advise leadership on new products, new markets and fundraising, and track new law.

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

- A qualified lawyer with 5+ years' experience in a tech-focused law firm or in-house legal team.

- Hands-on GDPR experience, including regulator contact, and strong commercial contract skills, ideally in SaaS.

- Knowledge of EU digital rules (DSA, AI Act, NIS2) or security frameworks such as ISO 27001 is a plus.

- Experience across several European countries.

- Fluent English, plus fluent French or German.

- A pragmatic generalist: you switch easily between topics, talk data flows with engineers and give clear, risk-based answers in plain words.

What we offer

- The chance to build Salonkee's legal function from day one.

- A strategic, high-impact role with direct exposure to the leadership team.

- A dynamic, international, and supportive work environment with a strong team culture.

- A competitive remuneration package.

- The opportunity to be part of a success story and make a tangible impact on the future of the beauty and wellness industry.

Salonkee is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. Together, let's create an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.
